title: Building an MCP server and exposing tools

videos.script: This lesson builds the MCP server the rest of the course uses: Marginalia's orders and help centre, as tools, resources and a prompt. {{title}} The schema says what the code checks: an order id is M and four digits, and a call with anything else is refused before the database is touched. {{schema}} Results are structured, and the output schema is an allow list: the customer's id is in the database and never leaves the server. {{output}} A failure says why, the help centre's articles are resources a host can read, and one prompt gives a person a starting point. {{rest}} And the server is tested the way it will be used: through a real MCP client, in the same process, seven tests that run in about a second. {{last}}
